newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia says one killed in F-16 crash.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia says one killed in F-16 crash.

text.p: Indonesian armed forces commander General Feisal Tanjung said on Tuesday one person died when an air force F-16 jet crashed while landing at the Halim Perdana Kusuma air base, Antara news agency reported.
Air force officials told Reuters an F-16 combat aircraft crashed at the air base in east Jakarta on Monday but declined to give other details.
Tanjung told reporters the aircraft crashed in bad weather when landing after a routine exercise above Jakarta.
The pilot, Captain Dwi Sasongko, died in the accident and his body was flown to Yogyakarta in Central Java on Tuesday morning for burial, he said.
Antara quoted Tanjung as ruling out sabotage as a cause for the accident but added the military was still investigating.
Indonesia's air force has more than 80 combat aircraft, including a number of F-16s made by Lockheed Martin Corp of the United States.
